findings.description: Joseph Martassek's parents were Joannes (János) Martassek and Maria Tizsinyák; he was baptised as Josephus Martassek at Krásno nad Kysucou in 1853.

details.baptism: 1853, Krásno nad Kysucou, Kysucké Nové Mesto, Slovakia

supporting_sources: Slovakia, Church and Synagogue Books, 1592-1935 — Krásno nad Kysucou (Karásznó) Catholic baptism register 1843-1896, entry for Josephus Martassek, baptised 1853, parents Joannes Martassek and Maria Tizsinyák
